question: How many orders are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: How many customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total), 2) FROM order_items

question: How many different products have been sold at least once?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FROM order_items

question: What is the average revenue per order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no), 2) FROM order_items

question: Which 5 countries have the highest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = o.country_id GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 10 products have sold the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.stock_code = oi.stock_code GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 10

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend?
gold_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 countries placed the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country_name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = o.country_id GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which product has the most returned units?
gold_sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, SUM(r.quantity) FROM returns r JOIN products p ON p.stock_code = r.stock_code GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY SUM(r.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer has returned the most units?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(quantity) FROM returns WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are from Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers cu JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = cu.country_id WHERE c.country_name = 'Germany'

question: What was the total revenue in November 2011?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no WHERE o.order_date >= '2011-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2011-12-01'

question: How many orders were placed in each calendar quarter of 2011? Give the quarter number from 1 to 4.
gold_sql: SELECT QUARTER(order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = 2011 GROUP BY QUARTER(order_date)

question: Which calendar month (year and month) had the highest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m'), ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: When was the most recent order placed?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders

question: Which day of the week has the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT DAYNAME(order_date), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY DAYNAME(order_date) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of orders were placed by anonymous customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(customer_id IS NULL) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders

question: What is the total value of returns?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total), 2) FROM returns

question: How many units were returned in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM returns

question: What is the net revenue, meaning sales minus returns?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM order_items) - (SELECT SUM(line_total) FROM returns), 2)

question: How many order lines are flagged as outliers?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(is_outlier) FROM order_items

question: How many customers have placed more than 10 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) t

question: What share of total revenue comes from the United Kingdom, as a percentage?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.country_name = 'United Kingdom' THEN oi.line_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.line_total), 1) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = o.country_id

question: Which product earned the most revenue in the United Kingdom?
gold_sql: SELECT p.stock_code, p.description, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.invoice_no = oi.invoice_no JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = o.country_id JOIN products p ON p.stock_code = oi.stock_code WHERE c.country_name = 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY p.stock_code, p.description ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer placed the most orders, and how many?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
